title: Annual Tech Fest - Innovate 2026
summary: Flagship university technology exhibition showcasing student robotics, project demonstrations, and industry keynote speakers.
description: Innovate 2026 brings together over 1,500 students, faculty, and industry pioneers. Features include live autonomous drone races, hardware hacking arenas, software project expos, and guest speeches from leading tech executives.

title: National 36-Hour Coding Hackathon
summary: Intensive team coding sprint tackling real-world problems in AI, healthcare technology, and green energy solutions.
description: Form teams of 2 to 4 developers and build end-to-end web, mobile, or AI prototypes within 36 hours. Cash prizes, cloud credits, and direct interview opportunities with sponsoring companies will be awarded.

title: Cultural Harmony Night & Music Gala
summary: An enchanting evening featuring classical dances, rock band performances, theatrical skits, and global food stalls.
description: Celebrate campus cultural diversity! Featuring performances from the university symphony, dramatic societies, folk dance troupes, and a special celebrity guest musical ensemble.

title: Inter-College Sports Championship 2026
summary: High-octane multi-sport tournament spanning Football, Cricket, Badminton, Volleyball, and Track & Field events.
description: Competing against 24 partner colleges across the state. Cheer for your departmental teams or participate in athletic trials. Medals, trophies, and athletic scholarships to be won.

title: Hands-on Generative AI & LLM Workshop
summary: Master practical prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and building multi-agent AI applications with modern frameworks.
description: A comprehensive practical workshop led by Google and HuggingFace community advocates. Bring your laptop to build interactive chatbots, RAG vector search pipelines, and autonomous agent loops.

title: Distinguished Lecture: Cybersecurity in Web3
summary: Keynote presentation exploring cryptographic vulnerabilities, zero-trust network architectures, and threat mitigation.
description: International guest speaker Dr. Elena Vance discusses state-sponsored cyber incursions, zero-day threat prevention, quantum cryptography resilience, and career paths in cybersecurity.

title: Campus Entrepreneurship & Startup Pitch Summit
summary: Pitch your startup venture to venture capitalists, angel investors, and seasoned alumni founders.
description: Selected student startup teams receive seed grants up to ₹2,50,000, 6 months of free incubation, cloud infrastructure credits, and direct legal/incorporation assistance.

title: Cloud Architecture & DevOps Masterclass
summary: Deep dive into Docker containers, Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code.
description: Interactive laboratory session where every attendee provisions automated microservice architectures on AWS and Google Cloud Platform, monitors telemetry, and deploys high-availability web apps.

title: Annual Parliamentary Debate Championship
summary: Sharpen your rhetoric, critical thinking, and spontaneous articulation in British Parliamentary style debate rounds.
description: Three competitive rounds debating domestic policy, international ethics, technology regulation, and climate economics. Open to individual debaters and adjudicators.

title: IoT & Smart Hardware Exhibition
summary: Exhibition of student-engineered microcontroller systems, smart agricultural sensors, and home automation kits.
description: Interact with working hardware demos featuring ESP32, Raspberry Pi 5, STM32, and LoRaWAN long-range telemetry modules applied to campus energy monitoring and automated plant care.

title: Digital Photography & Short Film Showcase
summary: Screening of student short documentaries, visual arts gallery, and camera lighting workshop.
description: Juried photography contest featuring categories in Street, Portrait, Nature, and Architecture photography. Film screenings followed by director Q&A sessions.

title: University Chess Grandmaster Tournament
summary: FIDE-rated rapid and blitz chess championship with digital clocks, live DGT boards, and streaming commentary.
description: 7 rounds of Swiss system tournament, 15m+10s time control. Open to all registered students and faculty members. Trophies and cash prizes for top 5 finishers.
